newsitem.title: CANADA: CBRS says downgrades Molson Breweries debt rating.
newsitem.headline: CBRS says downgrades Molson Breweries debt rating.

text.p: Canadian Bond Rating Service said on Tuesday that it has downgraded Molson Breweries unsecured debentures and revised its rating outlook.
CBRS said in a statement that the debenture rating has been cut to A+(low) from A+. The rating outlook was revised to stable from negative.
Molson is owned 40 percent each by Molson Cos Ltd and Foster's Brewing Group Ltd and 20 percent by Philip Morris Co's Miller Brewing unit.

"The rating change is a reflection of the company's weaker capital structure, earnings and cash flow, a loss of market share - especially acute in Quebec and increased competition in the Canadian beer industry," CBRS said.
